claims.head: The Wild want Kaprizov head to head with Horvat
claims.call: The Wild’s L1 (Kaprizov, Ek and Boldy) spends at least 48% of its 5-on-5 time against the Islanders’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Wild keep sending Kaprizov’s line (Kaprizov, Ek and Boldy) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. John Hynes has been choosing strength on strength. Tonight the Islanders’ first line is Holmström, Horvat and Palmieri.

claims.gist: At home, John Hynes likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Islanders’ first line.

notes.text: Mathew Barzal is on the injured non-roster list (knee injury) and has not played this season. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
Matias Maccelli is out 4-6 weeks (lower body injury) and has missed the last 2 games.
Mitchell Chaffee was added to the roster on Oct 20 and has played beside Casey Cizikas and Kyle MacLean.
Kyle Palmieri is no longer killing penalties: 0% of the team’s shorthanded time in 10 games, down from 37% last season.
Marcus Foligno is on injured reserve and has missed the last 7 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Maxim Shabanov is day to day (upper-body injury) and missed their last game. He is a top-six forward.
Brock Faber is on injured reserve (skull surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Jonas Brodin has taken his spot beside Quinn Hughes.
Tyler Pitlick was added to the roster on Oct 13 and has played beside Michael McCarron and Rieger Lorenz.

MIN.head: The Wild should have the upper hand
MIN.body: The Islanders will be without Barzal, while Minnesota has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Islanders’ way back in is a power play that gets going.

NYI.head: The Islanders face a real test
NYI.body: The Islanders will be without Barzal, while Minnesota has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Islanders can pull it off if their power play gets going.

items.text: The Wild are newly without Maxim Shabanov, have been without Marcus Foligno since Oct 8, and have had to make do without Filip Gustavsson and Brock Faber all season. Jesper Wallstedt is expected to start.
The Islanders are newly without Matias Maccelli, and have had to make do without Mathew Barzal all season.
